title: Deep Prasad harassed during UAP science work

tellings.quote: I I remember you faced some not so fun people kind of messing with you at some point in your UAP science investigation, you know, work where it felt like maybe you hit a nerve among >> some deep stater types or something. Am I wrong about that? >> You are not wrong at all.

plain: A researcher named Deep Prasad says unfriendly people interfered with him while he was doing scientific work on UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. Michels raises it, recalling that Prasad seemed to have "hit a nerve" among "deep stater types," meaning hidden insiders in government, and Prasad answers, "You are not wrong at all." If true, it would suggest someone was watching that research closely enough to push back.
